answer: Agents earn voting weight only after staking funds that remain locked through a challenge period; anyone can submit evidence that several accounts share one operator, and a successful challenge slashes their stake and removes their weight. This makes each new identity costly rather than free: a sybil attacker must lock substantial capital across accounts and risks losing it if links are proven. A karst-based registry can record those proofs, while orchard and pigment serve as ordinary labels, not identity evidence.
